verdicts.reason: Both leave the blurred photo as a big empty brown square, shrink the Quillbrook bag (the hero product) to a thumbnail, move the CTA above the headline and push the logo to the bottom, so reading order and hierarchy are inverted. In A the bag and logo are tiny, illegible specks spaced arbitrarily, so the brand is effectively lost. B is slightly less bad because its logo and bag are at least recognisable, but its CTA is right-aligned off the headline's left edge, the SAVE 15% pill floats in mid-space, and the subcopy is jammed under the headline.
